name: Curtain Call / Curtain Call 2 / Curtain Call 3

castTime.binNote: The wiki lists a dual cast time: 1s to begin the channel (Active) and 0.25s per recast. The bin's top-level castTime=1 matches only the Active activation; the 0.25 recast cast time is not separately represented here.

values.binNote: Not a direct bin row: computed as DamageCalc (base [64,128,192], ad 0.25) multiplied by FourthShotMultiplier=2, giving base [128,256,384] and ad coef 0.5. Neither the bin nor a single calculation states this doubled number directly; it is derived from the two named rows.

values.meaning: Damage amplification based on target's missing health
values.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}
Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Jhin channels for up to 10 seconds and can recast Curtain Call up to 4 times within that duration.
mechanics.quote: channels for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.

mechanics.claim: Each recast fires after a 0.2s delay into the 0.25s cast time and the bullet stops upon hitting the first enemy champion it hits.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction... The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion

mechanics.claim: The fourth shot critically strikes for bonus physical damage (double damage, per FourthShotMultiplier), independent of crit chance/crit damage stats.
mechanics.quote: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.

mechanics.claim: Curtain Call applies spell damage to enemy champions and area damage to other enemy units, meaning non-champion units may take different damage handling.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to enemy champions and {{tip|area damage}} to other enemy units.

mechanics.claim: Each recast counts as a separate ability activation, triggering on-cast effects like Spellblade for each of the up to 4 shots.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The ability's on-use cooldown begins only after the channel/recast sequence ends (post-effect), not on initial cast.
Curtain Call can be blocked by spell shields.
